decisions.reason: Certified HVAC gasketed plate heat exchangers are close to the core offer and serve steady demand, though their absence from the website in 2020-2021 adds some uncertainty.
The marine box cooler line reportedly holds a major market share in water cooling systems, which makes it a strong product to retain despite the recent website gaps.
The marine cooling unit complements the box cooler line and the marine service business, though as a single product it is more exposed to portfolio streamlining.
The compact oil cooler line builds on established competence with recurring industrial and transportation demand, so withdrawal is unlikely but not ruled out.
Finned tubes feed the firm's own air cooler production, but as a component offering similar to the withdrawn enhanced tubes they carry some risk of consolidation.
